insert into es_user_profile (event_id,user_id,user_name,user_favorite_card_id,user_favorite_card_evolved,user_award1_id,user_award1_value,user_award2_id,user_award2_value,location) values
( #{profile.eventId}, #{profile.userId}, #{profile.userName}, #{profile.userFavoriteCardId}, #{profile.userFavoriteCardEvolved}, coalesce(#{profile.userAward1Id},-1), coalesce(#{profile.userAward1Value},-1), coalesce(#{profile.userAward2Id},-1), coalesce(#{profile.userAward2Value},-1), #{profile.location} )
on conflict (user_id) do update set user_id = excluded.user_id, user_name = excluded.user_name, user_favorite_card_id = excluded.user_favorite_card_id, user_favorite_card_evolved = excluded.user_favorite_card_evolved, user_award1_id = excluded.user_award1_id, user_award1_value = excluded.user_award1_value, user_award2_id = excluded.user_award2_id, user_award2_value = excluded.user_award2_value, location = excluded.location, update_time = current_timestamp
